Noa (Sales): Quick request — Boreal.ai wants a hosted POC demo next Tue. They need a short demo spike and a lower sustained smoke window. Can infra provision an ephemeral key + temporary quota?
Hector (Infra): Numbers and windows?
Noa (Sales): Demo peak 520 rps for 8 minutes, then 75 rps sustained for 2.5 hours. Streaming SSE from their backend. Small token sizes.
Luis (Platform): We can do an ephemeral scoped key with a burst window and automatic fallback. Streaming raises concurrent connection requirements; we can bump the per-key limit.
Mina (Security): Requirements: server-to-server only (static egress IPs), key TTL <= 72h (48h preferred), scope limited to generation only, redact logs, no raw payload export. SOC contact required.
Noa (Sales): They can egress from 52.12.34.0/24. TTL 36h is fine. SOC: security@boreal.ai.
Hector (Infra): I'll create override: burst_rate=520 rps window=8m, sustained_rate=75 rps until end_time. Increasing concurrent streaming connections to 140 for this key. Need ticket with IPs + windows.
Greta (SRE): I'll attach a lightweight dashboard and alert to #eng-oncall: error_rate > 2% or p95 latency > 1.4s. Also watch SSE connection churn.
Luis (Platform): Key scope locked to generation:invoke only. Disable embeddings/rerank. Token tracing off, redaction on. If sustained >75 rps outside the demo we will route to rw-gpt-3.5-medium automatically.
Noa (Sales): Demo window: 2029-02-20T17:00:00Z - 2029-02-20T20:00:00Z, demo burst 17:30-17:38Z. Ticket REDWOOD-POC-812 created.
(provision-bot): Ephemeral key created: id ephem_x4m8r, scope=generation:invoke, expires in 36h, IP allowlist applied. See REDWOOD-POC-812.
Hector (Infra): Sample curl (replace <KEY>):
```
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate \\
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \\
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
 -d '{"model":"rw-gpt-7b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"get recs"}],"stream":true}'
```
Hector (Infra): Note: concurrent conn limit bumped to 140 for this key. Use connection pooling for best throughput.
Noa (Sales): Sending to Boreal now. They asked: if they keep 75 rps steady for a month, any run-rate estimate?
Luis (Platform): Rough estimate: ~ $2.05k/mo for sustained 75 rps on rw-gpt-7b under current token assumptions. I'll draft a pricing note.
Boreal (customer via email): Smoke test reached ~500 rps streaming, no errors. Key works.
Noa (Sales): Thanks everyone — ping me if anything unusual during the demo.
Greta (SRE): Monitoring live; I'll be watching the channel during the demo window and will post any anomalies in REDWOOD-POC-812.
Mina (Security): Confirmed logs retention limited for the POC and key will auto-expire per TTL.
